binance_security_event.attack_chain_interpretation: Binance reported no evidence of wallet private-key leakage. The disclosed chain is an endpoint, identity, credential, deployment-permission and signing-service compromise, not an XRPL consensus exploit or proof that an AI model itself was compromised.
binance_security_event.native_xrp_freeze_rule: Native XRP has no issuer and cannot be frozen by Ripple or another XRPL participant. Issued tokens such as RLUSD have issuer freeze controls; custodial exchanges can freeze assets held in their own custody.

attribution_disagreement.law_enforcement: FBI attributed the incident to DPRK TraderTraitor activity.
attribution_disagreement.independent_intelligence: TRM Labs assessed the incident as high-confidence TraderTraitor/DPRK activity based on on-chain and off-chain intelligence.

attribution_disagreement.us_presidential_qualification: AP reported President Trump said investigators had not yet established whether North Korea was responsible.
attribution_disagreement.assessment: Preserve the FBI attribution, TRM assessment, DPRK denial and presidential qualification. The attribution is not a court judgment; do not silently discard the denial or treat it as forensic disconfirmation.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Recent ETF holdings/flow observations may reflect continued institutional allocation or modest redemptions depending on fund universe and settlement vintage.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Trackers disagree, latest rows are partial/provisional, and no synchronized issuer cash creation/redemption records were captured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC/RLUSD distribution and payment-network expansion could compete with XRP bridge liquidity or increase the broader on-chain settlement addressable market.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No XRP-specific bridge volume, net XRP acquisition, or measured substitution elasticity is disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.claim: XRPL lending and vault amendments could create future collateral and liquidity use cases if activated.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: LendingProtocol has 19/35 votes and requires 29 plus a continuous two-week threshold; activation and utilization are not established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Dollar/yield weakness may support risk appetite.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The Guardian reported a weaker dollar, lower Treasury yields and lower Brent after the election, while AP reported energy-driven inflation and an expected BoE hike. These are different markets, timestamps and policy channels; no causal XRP response is established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The stolen 233.46M XRP may create idiosyncratic supply or custody uncertainty.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No sale or exchange deposit is established; Binance's 98% replenishment statistic is aggregate impacted-token replenishment, not XRP recovery.

competing_hypotheses.claim: FBI and TRM attribute the incident to DPRK TraderTraitor; the FBI identifies North Korean state-sponsored activity.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: DPRK denied involvement, and AP reported the US president said investigators had not yet established responsibility. The denial is not independent forensic evidence, but it must remain in the event record.

predictive_admission.admission_rule: No directional forecast until raw source receipts, independent timestamps, synchronized venue/contract definitions, issuer-level ETF vintages, event features, chronological walk-forward results, baseline comparisons, calibration and drift checks support it.
keep_features_separate: ETF per-fund holdings and publication status
prohibitions: Do not equate OI with spot capital.
Do not equate ETF holdings deltas with cash creations/redemptions.
Do not equate stablecoin transaction volume with XRP settlement.
Do not classify stolen exchange-wallet movements as organic flows.
Do not infer lending activation or collateral utilization from incomplete validator votes.
